title: Pure Watt
summary: Watt cards only, with generic Thunder Extra Deck monsters and staples. Watt monsters are small LIGHT Thunders that attack directly, and each direct hit locks the opponent down. Wattgiraffe stops them activating cards for the turn, Wattcobra searches another Watt, and the Watt Synchros strip cards from the hand or Deck. The 2023 cards lead. Wattkingdom summons a different Watt from the Deck and stops their on-summon effects in the same columns. Wattsychic Fighting Porter summons two small LIGHT monsters from the hand that can attack directly. Wattuna follows a hit by Synchro Summoning any Watt Synchro of the right Level. Wattkyuki shuffles a Tuner and a Thunder back to summon another Watt Synchro. Wattrain searches one Watt card for each Thunder you control. Wattkingdom limits you to Thunders for the turn.
